claim_boundary: The theorem closes only invariants additive on every short exact sequence, including Grothendieck-group and Euler-characteristic scalarizations of resolutions. It does not close raw Betti tables, non-exact partial Euler characteristics, persistence rank invariants, minimal syzygy functors with a separately proved monotone envelope, representation-valued data, nonlinear determinantal loci, valuative arguments, Chow-realizability defects, border rank, exact rank for n>=6, or general Glynn optimality.
frozen_scope: theorem core and replay counts; diagnostic rows are regenerated

theorem.chow_ceiling: For permanent versus the Boolean Chow-term envelope, every such scalar rank ratio is at most binom(n,floor(n/2)).
theorem.exact_additive_scalar: Every short-exact-additive nonnegative scalar has the form Phi(M)=sum_d c_d dim(M_d) with c_d>=0.
theorem.graded_K0: K_0 of finite-length graded k[s,t]-modules is freely generated by the shifts k(-d), and [M]=sum_d dim(M_d)[k(-d)].
theorem.resolution_Euler: Every exact-additive alternating scalar extracted from a finite graded free resolution factors through the Hilbert function.
